title: Selection proof: Proof strip
topics: Greedy choices, dynamic programming and backtracking
summary: Choose any subset of reading positions, including the empty subset, and sum its readings. Produce every distinct achievable sum in ascending order. Equal readings at different positions remain separate choices. Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n*2^n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(2^n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.

referenceSolutions.python:
def selectionProofProofStrip(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    sums=set()
    def visit(i,s):
        if i==len(a):
            sums.add(s)
            return
        visit(i+1,s)
        visit(i+1,s+a[i])
    visit(0,0)
    out=sorted(sums)
    return out
